We are excited to announce the Lou Trapani Legacy Scholarship . An opportunity designed to continue giving young artists the chance to thrive, just as Lou did. This year, we will award a one-time scholarship of $1000, or two one-time scholarships of $500 each. To learn more, please visit the Lou Trapani Legacy Scholarship page on our site . How You Can Help: You can contribute to the Lou Trapani Legacy Scholarship Fund by making a donation today and selecting Lou Trapani Legacy Scholarship when prompted to make a category selection at checkout. Your support will help us provide these scholarships to the next generation of talented artists, ensuring Lou’s commitment to arts education continues to flourish. Emails Become A Member Register Our trained instructors teach Tap, Ballet, Pointe, Hip-Hop, Musical Theater, Acro, Lyrical, and Contemporary. We offer classes for ages 3 and up! CENTERstage Dance Studio is an Acrobatic Arts certified studio . Please read all of the following information and contact us with questions. CENTERstage Dance Studio offers a variety of levelled classes for ages 3-adult. We offer a fun environment with quality instruction. Our season follows the school year, with a new season beginning each September and concluding in May. We typically offer a summer session each year. Our 2024-2025 season is broken into three sessions: Session 1: September 9-November 1, 2024 Session 2: November 4, 2024- February 14, 2025 (no class 11/25-11/29; 12/23-1/3) Session 3: February 17- May 9, 2025 (no class 4/14-4/18) Recital Week: May 12-16; Recital Saturday May 17 Most of our classes perform at a recital in May, and though all students will learn the choreography, students are not required to perform in the recital. We accept new students during our summer session and during our first and second sessions during the school year season. We are not accepting new students to our classes in session 3. In this case, new student means a student who has not been enrolled since Session 2 of the season. We do not automatically enroll students.  Everyone must register for every session. GENERAL INFORMATION MONEY MATTERS A nonrefundable deposit is required to secure a spot in each class. We reserve the right to charge a transfer fee- please check your classes before registering! A payment plan is available each session. Registrants are responsible for keeping track of payment dates and for keeping their payment information current. A payment plan is available for the 2024-2025 season with the following schedule: For Session 1: $30 deposit due at registration, payment 1 on September 20, payment 2 on October 18. For Session 2: $30 deposit due at registration, payment 1 on November 18, payment 2 on December 2, Payment 3 on January 3. For Session 3: $30 deposit due at registration, payment 1 on March 7, payment 2 on April 4, Payment 3 on May 2. Registrations cancelled mid-session are not eligible for a refund.  We are not able to prorate tuition for late registrations. We offer two discount options: The Individual Unlimited Dance Pass is recommended for anyone registering for four or more hour long classes or five or more 45 minute classes in a session. You must choose this option when registering online. Registrants are encouraged to add up their class total to see if the Unlimited Pass is the better option for them. A 15% Multiperson Discount for family members who register at the same time. If applicable, the multiperson discount is applied automatically upon check out. Credit card payments can be taken online or over the phone. Note: Your payment may show up on your billing statement as ACT*RhinebeckPACENTER or ACT*RPA, Inc. If you wish to pay by CASH or CHECK, please call Victoria at 845-876-3088. Checks must be made out to RPA, Inc. RECITAL Our recital is planned for Saturday May 17, 2025 . If you choose to take part in the recital, there will be separate instructions sent regarding costume and shoe requirements. Please note that these requirements vary in cost. Please ask your dance instructor any recital gear questions. Summer session does not have a recital. POLICIES Students and parents/guardians must read and agree to our Studio Agreement before registering. Our classes are closed sessions. Adults should ask the instructor before entering the studios. In the event that a class must be canceled, we will attempt to get a substitute for that class.  If we cannot, we will schedule a makeup class when our schedule permits.  We try to keep makeup classes to a minimum. NOTE FOR PARENTS/GUARDIANS: We do not have the space for all adults and students to wait in our green room during classes. Participants only are permitted inside the theatre during classes. Parents/guardians are invited to wait in our parking lot or take advantage of the charms of the town of Rhinebeck. By registering your dancer, you are agreeing to this policy. PREDANCE PARENTS/GUARDIANS: Predance parents/guardians may wait in the green room but may not watch the class. By registering your dancer, you are agreeing to this policy. At this time, masks are optional but encouraged. All students that enter the theatre must sanitize their hands, and we ask anyone who is sick to please stay home. Please note that our policies can change at any time. Animals are not permitted in our theatre. Please note that we do not have reliable WiFi in our studio. Class Calendar and Registration Link We have adult classes! text: The CENTER for Performing Arts at Rhinebeck is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization that is dedicated, through its arts and education programs, to providing arts experiences for people of all ages, cultures, and backgrounds.
label: NON-EVENT

text: Maximize the use of its facility as a true community resource
label: NON-EVENT

text: Design and/or develop complementary arts programs at area schools
label: NON-EVENT

text: Provide opportunities for hands-on technical and performance training in all aspects of theatre arts leading toward presentation
label: NON-EVENT

text: Assist in the development of individual and group performers by offering them the opportunity to benefit from The CENTER's facility, rich technical resources, and professional expertise.
label: NON-EVENT

text: The CENTER for Performing Arts at Rhinebeck strives for diversity, inclusion, and equity as it is connected to our mission and critical to ensuring the well-being of our staff, volunteers, and the community we serve. We affirm the fundamental rights of all to feel valued and respected and embrace differences in gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, age, sexual orientation or identity, education, or disability that make our community rich.
label: NON-EVENT

text: We are committed to growing an inclusive environment with equitable treatment for all, including a non-discriminatory, anti-racist approach, and providing equal opportunity for employment and advancement in all of our work.
label: NON-EVENT

text: If you would like to join the conversation or have any thoughts or concerns, please e-mail us
label: NON-EVENT

text: We commit to producing and amplifying voices from underserved communities in our programming, and to seeking out, empowering, and creating safe spaces for those who have historically been marginalized or silenced.
label: NON-EVENT

text: All Production Companies using The CENTER are obligated to honor this policy.
label: NON-EVENT

text: *Lead Production Staff refers to Musical and Stage Directors, Assistant Directors, Stage Managers, Assistant Stage Managers, and Producers who are 18 or older.
label: NON-EVENT

text: **For more information or our full policy, please contact one of the committee member listed above.
